native_layout: A film blend contains each named native component scene. CLI joins components without rescaling: film 02 OFF above ON; film 03 phase above paired OFF/ON intensity sections.

flow_approximation_limits.interpretation: Approximate J/I power-flow display. Do not measure tiny individual-ray displacement or reflection-point shifts from these lines. Rendering coordinate fidelity is not physical streamline accuracy.

isosurface_display_shading.interpretation: Shared normal-based display shading makes the saved 3D shape visible; it is not quantitative intensity or measured scattered brightness.

core_boundary_guide.scope: Display annotation on y=0, x=+/-25 um throughout the actual circular core. Not simulated light.
